 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Conscientous"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Conscientious"**, which means wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. (ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a conscientious worker who always completes her tasks on time.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"Conscientious"** (ईमानदार).
 
 
• **Example: **His conscientious nature makes him a valuable team member.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Committee** (समिति): A group of people appointed for a specific function.

 
 
• **Example:** The committee will meet next week to discuss the new project.
 
 
 
• **Achieve** (प्राप्त करना): Successfully reach a desired objective or result.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to achieve her goals.
 
 
 
• **Necessary** (आवश्यक): Required to be done, achieved, or present.
 
 
• **Example:** It is necessary to stay hydrated in hot weather.
